answer: At task opening, the requester issues one signed, single-use claim ticket per deliverable and fixes the ticket count before submissions; settlement consumes each nonce and rejects replays across keys. A garden task can classify saffron using a prism scan, but copied aliases cannot multiply the fixed reward slots. Proposed ticket cost per identity claim: $0.15 × 1,000 = $150, versus a proposed $0.15 one-time cost for one honest agent. Limitation: a colluding requester can still issue excess tickets to a farm.
